text: Based on the tool output, we can confirm that the forest has been largely intact since 2020. The observation tools detected tree cover in 2000 and forest in 2020, covering 91.77% of the asset. The data from both the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD) and the European Commission Joint Research Centre corroborate that the forest has remained predominantly intact. The latest observed year is 2025, ensuring recent data. Therefore, it is reasonable to conclude that the forest has been intact since 2020.
